_note: Godot 3.x APIs that a model trained on years of Godot 3 tutorials will confidently emit. A hit is a hard failure in `make check`. Add a rule the first time any Godot-3-ism gets past review. Escape hatch: put 'godot4-lint: ignore' on the line. Lives in a data file, not in the linter, so the linter does not flag its own patterns.

rules.why: Godot 3 node name — Godot 4 suffixes dimension (Node3D, Camera3D, MeshInstance3D, Area3D, CharacterBody3D)
Godot 3 type — use Node3D / RenderingServer / Quaternion / PackedXArray
Godot 3 setget — use a property with get:/set:
Godot 3 connect(name, self, method) — use signal.connect(callable)
Godot 3 math helper — deg_to_rad, rad_to_deg, randf_range, snapped, linear_to_db, db_to_linear
Godot 3 OS window API — use DisplayServer
Godot 3 raycast signature — Godot 4 takes a PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D
Godot 3 Geometry singleton — split into Geometry2D / Geometry3D in Godot 4 (this project's own helpers are FlightGeometry)
